title: RunConfig
description: Input contract for a single benchmark run. Shared shape across engines; engine-specific tuning lives under per-engine keys: the Spark jar reads 'spark_config', the Flink jar reads 'flink_config'. Mirrors clustering.benchmark.config.RunConfig in each engine repo.

runId.description: Globally unique id; becomes the result filename stem (<runId>.json).

profile.description: Cluster profile. If absent, the engine auto-detects from env (e.g. SLURM_JOB_ID).

type.description: DataSource type, e.g. 'synthetic' | 'parquet' | 'csv'. Resolved by each engine's DataSource registry.

params.description: Free-form source params (e.g. numPoints, numPartitions, seed, path, weightColumn). Each engine parses what it needs. weightColumn names a per-row weight (how many points the row stands for); absent means every row weighs 1.0.

name.description: Algorithm name, e.g. 'kmeans' | 'bisectingkmeans' | 'pam' | 'fastpam' | 'fasterpam' | 'clara' | 'alternate' | 'pamae' | 'dbscanpp' | 'dbscanexact'. Resolved by each engine's algorithm registry.

params.description: Free-form algorithm params (e.g. k, maxIter, distance, geometry, eps, minPts, coreSampleFraction, sampling, assign, inner, poolSize, refineIters, refine, m0, seed).

sampleSize.description: Optional cap for O(n^2) metrics like silhouette. null/absent = full dataset.

seed.description: RNG seed for evaluation sampling. Defaults to 42 in the engine if absent.

spark_config.description: Extra Spark configuration entries (SparkConf) set before session start. Read by the Spark jar; absent/ignored for Flink runs.

flink_config.description: Extra Flink configuration entries (execution config) set before session start. Read by the Flink jar; absent/ignored for Spark runs.

outputDir.description: Overrides the profile's default output directory when present.

experimentMetadata.description: Free-form key->value tags describing the experiment setup (nodes, cores, memory, walltime, module, ...). Written verbatim into the result for analysis.
